services.title: Services
services.h1: Brand representation, sourcing and import-export trading
services.lead: As a commercial agent and trader, ALIOM TRADING supports brands that want to grow in Morocco and buyers looking for a reliable supplier.
services.seoDescription: Commercial agent in Morocco: representation of international brands, supplier sourcing, import, export, quality control and logistics from Casablanca.

items.title: Brand representation
items.text: We represent international brands in Morocco: prospecting, presenting to distributors, following up orders and customers, and reporting market information.

items.title: Supplier sourcing
items.text: We find and select the producers that match your specification, in Morocco and abroad, and compare the offers for you.

items.title: Import
items.text: Timber, polymers, raw materials: we import for Moroccan manufacturers and coordinate transport, customs clearance and delivery.

items.title: Export
items.text: Seafood, citrus, fruit and vegetables: we supply foreign importers with Moroccan products, by the container or in lots.

items.title: Quality control
items.text: Plants selected against HACCP, IFS and BRC requirements, pre-loading checks and independent inspection on request.

items.title: Logistics and documents
items.text: Cold chain, containers, health and origin certificates, shipping documents: we prepare the file with you.

steps.title: Your need
steps.text: Product, specification, volumes, destination and timing.

steps.title: Our selection
steps.text: We consult our sources and propose the best offer.

steps.title: Inspection
steps.text: Quality, quantity and packing checked before departure.

steps.title: Delivery
steps.text: Transport and documents followed through to your warehouse.

services.brandsText: Looking for an agent to grow your sales in Morocco? Introduce your brand and products: we review every proposal.

legal.title: Legal notice
legal.lead: Information about the publisher of this website and about how we handle the personal data you send us.

sections.p: ALIOM TRADING, single-member SARL with a share capital of MAD 500,000. Registered office: 2-4 rue Abou Dhabi, Oasis, Casablanca, Morocco. Casablanca trade register no. 502559. ICE: 002810898000009. Managing director and publication director: Mrs Habiba Ouliass. Contact: info@aliomtrading.com, +212 6 60 16 11 57.
The website is hosted by the company’s hosting provider, whose details are available on request.
The texts, the ALIOM TRADING name and logo belong to the company. Illustrative photographs come from royalty-free image libraries. Reproduction without permission is prohibited.
Only what you type into the contact and quote forms: name, company, e-mail address, phone number, country, the products you selected and your message.
We use this data to answer your request and, if you become a customer, to prepare and follow up offers and orders. Enquiries that do not lead to business are deleted after 24 months.
We do not sell your data. Form messages pass through our e-mail provider; logistics partners only receive what is needed for a delivery.
This website sets no tracking cookies. Your quote selection is stored in your own browser (local storage) and only sent to us when you submit the form.

Under Moroccan Law 09-08 on the protection of individuals with regard to the processing of personal data, you have the right to access, correct and object to the use of your data. Write to info@aliomtrading.com.
